{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel value
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Replace sentinel values with NaN
data_clean = data.copy()
data_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = data_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(sentinel_value, pd.NA)

# Convert biomarker_baseline to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
data_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = pd.to_numeric(data_clean['biomarker_baseline'], errors='coerce')

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value, excluding sentinel and invalid values
mean_baseline = data_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean(numeric_only=True)

# Output the result
mean_baseline"}
